content:
Question: Does the Pro plan include audit-log CSV export for account A-193?

Retrieved context:
[S1] Pricing page, updated 2026-03-01: Pro includes API access, team seats, and basic audit-event viewing. CSV export is listed under Enterprise.
[S2] Help-center article, updated 2026-02-14: Pro customers can view audit events in the dashboard. Export requires Enterprise.
[S3] Sales FAQ, updated 2026-04-10: Pro includes audit-log CSV export for accounts created after 2026-04-01.
[S4] Account record: A-193 is on Pro and was created on 2026-03-20.
[S5] Changelog, updated 2026-04-15: The Sales FAQ entry about Pro CSV export was published early and applies only after backend rollout flag audit_csv_pro=true.
[S6] Account flags: A-193 audit_csv_pro=false.

Answer the question for account A-193.
